headline: TECTONIC METALS HITS 5.09 g/t Au OVER 21m AT BLACK CREEK — SECOND GOLD CENTER EMERGING 6km FROM FLAT MAIN ZONE IN ALASKA
snippet: Tectonic Metals (TSXV: TECT) reported 5.09 g/t gold over 21.34 metres in hole CMR26-152 at the Black Creek Target, including 17.34 g/t over 6.1 metres from 77.7 metres depth. The result confirms a second consecutive season of high-grade mineralization at Black Creek — approximately six kilometres northeast of the bulk-tonnage Chicken Mountain target at the 99,840-acre Flat Gold Project in southwest Alaska — raising the prospect of a distinct second intrusive gold center at the flagship property.

headline: NEXGOLD HITS 84.30 g/t OVER 1m IN GOLDLUND ZONE 4, EXPANDS ONTARIO DRILL PROGRAM FROM 25,000 TO 35,000 METRES
snippet: NexGold Mining (TSXV: NEXG) released results from 4,686 metres of drilling at the Goldlund Deposit in Ontario's Goliath Gold Complex, highlighted by 84.30 g/t gold over 1.0 metre, 4.80 g/t over 5.6 metres, and 3.08 g/t over 17.0 metres in Zone 4. The company immediately expanded its initial 25,000-metre program to approximately 35,000 metres on the strength of continued high-grade extensions, signalling confidence that the northeast open-pit portion of Goldlund holds more resource than previously modelled.

headline: FURY GOLD RETURNS 14.41 g/t OVER 3.92m AT EAU CLAIRE — JAMES BAY PHASE 2 PROGRAM CONVERTING HIGH-GRADE INFERRED TO INDICATED
snippet: Fury Gold Mines (TSX: FURY) released the third batch of Phase 2 infill assays from the Eau Claire Gold Project in the James Bay region of northern Quebec, headlined by 14.41 g/t Au over 3.92 metres in hole 26EC-125 and multiple additional intercepts above 5 g/t over 5+ metres. The 15,000–25,000-metre program is focused on category conversion rather than discovery drilling, with assays now in from 22 holes covering 11,423 metres — a key step toward updated project economics.

headline: SILVER NOTCHES 17% MONTHLY GAIN TO $68.63 — BEST AUGUST PERFORMANCE IN A DECADE AS SOLAR, EV AND DATA CENTRE DEMAND DEEPENS STRUCTURAL DEFICIT
snippet: Silver held $68.63 per ounce on August 26, notching a 17% gain for August alone — its strongest monthly performance in over a decade. The rally is driven by tightening above-ground inventories, constrained mine supply (silver is predominantly a by-product metal), and accelerating industrial demand from solar, EV batteries, and AI data centre applications. Year-over-year, silver has gained more than 173% at recent highs, meaningfully outpacing gold's rally.

headline: URANIUM EQUITIES OUTPACE SPOT 4-TO-1 IN AUGUST — DENISON +33%, ENERGY FUELS +39%, NUCLEAR ETF POSTS BEST MONTH SINCE JANUARY
snippet: The VanEck Uranium and Nuclear ETF gained 16% in August — its best month since January — while uranium spot barely moved, rising less than 4% to $89.55/lb. Energy Fuels led with a 39% gain, Uranium Energy added 38%, and Denison Mines surged 33%, with Cameco up a more measured 5.74%. The equity-vs-spot divergence signals a sector re-rating based on long-term contracting momentum and AI-driven nuclear demand rather than near-term spot prices — the classic setup that preceded the 2021 and 2024 uranium equity supercycles.

headline: NV GOLD STARTS DRILLING SLUMBER GOLD IN NEVADA — NEWLY-ACQUIRED LAND MAY BRIDGE TWO PREVIOUSLY ISOLATED TARGET AREAS
snippet: NV Gold Corporation (TSXV: NVX) commenced its 2026 drill program at the Slumber Gold Project, 60 miles northwest of Winnemucca in Humboldt County, Nevada. The initial program focuses on newly-acquired privately-held land that potentially connects two distinct target areas drilled separately between 2019 and 2025 — testing whether continuous mineralization runs beneath the gap and could materially expand the property's resource potential.

headline: ALMADEX SPUDS FIRST HOLE AT KING COPPER-GOLD PORPHYRY — COLORADO DISTRICT-SCALE TARGET GETS ITS FIRST DRILL TEST
snippet: Almadex Minerals (TSX-V: DEX) commenced drilling at its King copper-gold porphyry exploration target in south-central Colorado, testing porphyry-style alteration and mineralization identified through surface geochemistry and geophysics in a historically productive district. King is Almadex's second concurrent US drill program alongside the Altiplano gold-copper project, with management pointing to the under-explored porphyry district as the key attraction for first-pass drilling.

headline: GDX HITS $104 IN GOLD MINERS' BEST WEEK IN YEARS — RETAIL POURS $419M INTO ETF AS BULLION BREAKS THREE-MONTH HIGH
snippet: The VanEck Gold Miners ETF (GDX) reached $104.94 on August 25, capping one of its strongest weekly moves in years with a 20%+ gain as gold bullion climbed to three-month highs near $4,697. Retail investors channelled $419 million into GDX during August — on pace for the ETF's strongest monthly intake since February — though the RSI has climbed to 73.49, flagging technically overbought conditions that have historically preceded short-term consolidation in gold equities.

headline: KALKINE: 10 ASX MINING STOCKS TO WATCH AUGUST 26 — GOLD, COPPER, LITHIUM, SILVER AND MANGANESE PLAYS FOR THE SMALL-CAP RALLY
snippet: Kalkine's August 26 ASX mining watchlist identifies 10 small-cap resource stocks across gold, copper, lithium, silver, and manganese — metals with structurally constructive supply-demand setups as of mid-2026. The piece argues that retail investor participation in ASX resource stocks has lagged underlying commodity moves, creating a potential entry window in junior miners before broader market recognition arrives.
